blocks.text: After breakfast, another half-day excursion (4 hours), through the lush Tijuca Forest, one of the largest urban forests in the world, home to an extraordinary variety of tropical flora and fauna, to the summit of Corcovado, where Christ the Redeemer overlooks the city. Named one of the New Seven Wonders of the World, the monument offers breathtaking panoramic views of Rio, its famous beaches, mountains and Guanabara Bay.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to Rio de Janeiro airport for your flight to Foz do Iguaçu, where your driver meets you for the transfer to your hotel. In the afternoon, discover the Brazilian side of the magnificent Iguazu Falls on a guided tour: scenic walkways along the canyon offer spectacular views of countless cascades surrounded by lush Atlantic rainforest, culminating at the impressive Devil’s Throat, where you feel the power of the water and admire the rainbows in the spray. Recommended optional activities: a thrilling Macuco Safari boat adventure or a visit to the colourful Bird Park.

A DVD recording of the trip can be ordered.

**Bird Park in Iguazu**

Optional. Cost: $50 per person.
